clusters.headline: Trump Orders US Navy to Replace Modern Jet Launch System With Steam Catapults

members.title: Trump Orders Navy To Return To Older System Of Launching Jets Off Aircraft Carriers
Trump orders Pentagon to scrap modern jet launching tech on new US aircraft carrier and revert to steam catapults – as it happened
Trump orders US aircraft carriers to go back to steam catapults

clusters.summary: President Trump has ordered the Pentagon to abandon the modern electromagnetic aircraft launch system used on new US aircraft carriers and revert to the older steam catapult technology. The directive applies to the Navy's jet launching systems on its aircraft carriers, marking a shift away from the newer technology that had been implemented on newer vessels.

clusters.headline: Kennedy Center board approves naming renovation after Trump

members.title: Kennedy Center board approves Trump name on facade, renovation plan
Kennedy Centre board votes to put Trump’s name on the building – again

clusters.summary: The board of the Kennedy Center has voted to approve a renovation plan that includes putting Trump's name on the building's facade. This marks a reaffirmation of an earlier decision to name the facility after the former president.
